sentences.en: I am counting on you to deliver the opening address.
sentences.zh: 我指望你能发表开幕致辞。

sentences.en: Because of the contract, he is bound to deliver them.
sentences.zh: 因为合同在身，他不得不履行交付的义务。

sentences.en: The newspaper boy delivers papers in any kind of weather.
sentences.zh: 送报员无论什么天气都要把报纸送到。
